title: Towards Real Unsupervised Anomaly Detection Via Confident Meta-Learning (CoMet)
mechanism: Model-agnostic training on uncurated data: soft confident learning down-weights low-confidence samples, meta-learning regularises updates via validation-loss covariance.
adaptation: Train pool-based AD models on the raw 11.9k (later 159k) pool, which contains defects, instead of filtering by the house ensemble (which biases banks toward cells the house model handles).
evidence: R: SOTA on MVTec AD, VIADUCT, KSDD2 with two base models; insensitive to anomalies in the training set.
min_experiment: Arm: CoMet-wrapped Dinomaly2 on raw pool; baseline: Dinomaly2 on house-clean pool. Metric: CV inactive and crack-band pixel AUROC. Kill: difference < 1 AUROC point, then keep the filtered pool.
